description: an item comment whose text lists deny-rule names
command: orca bot item comment 133 --text "deny rules such as secrets.json, *.pem, .ssh/config stay" ; ps -axo command | grep -c "agent-guard/3.11.[345]"

description: an item comment read from a dotenv file
command: orca bot item comment 133 --text-file .env

description: a new item whose title, description and done-means name protected files
command: orca bot item add --title 'document .env names' --description 'covers *.pem' --done-means 'secrets.json listed'

description: a new item whose description is read from a dotenv file
command: orca bot item add --title t --description-file .env

description: a bot reply whose text names a dotenv file
command: orca bot reply --text 'the .env rule fired'

description: a bot reply note, which names a path
command: orca bot reply --text 'x' --note .env:1:comment

description: two orca message commands, each piped to tail
command: orca orchestration reply --id m1 --body 'about .env' | tail -1; orca orchestration send --to a --subject 's *.pem' --body 'b secrets.json' | tail -1

description: a message command after one whose output is written to a file
command: orca orchestration reply --id m1 --body 'x' > ./orca; orca orchestration send --to a --subject s --body '.env'

description: a commit message after git add
command: git add a.txt && git commit -q -m 'mention .env and *.pem'

description: git add of a dotenv file before the commit
command: git add .env && git commit -q -m 'add file'

description: a message body that starts with a list dash
command:
orca orchestration send --to run:r1 --type status --subject "s" --body "- one (*.pem etc).
  path: docs/notes.md
- two" --json | head -c 60

description: a body value shaped like a file option
command: orca orchestration send --to run:r1 --subject s --body '--body-file=.env'

description: the Orca CLI word as the command name
command: "${ORCA_CLI_COMMAND:-orca}" bot item comment 21 --text "the .env rule and secrets.json" | tail -1

description: another variable as the command name
command: O="${ORCA_CLI_COMMAND:-orca}"; $O bot item comment 21 --text "the .env rule" | tail -1

description: the unquoted Orca CLI word as the command name
command: ${ORCA_CLI_COMMAND:-orca} orchestration send --to a --subject s --body 'see .env'

description: the Orca CLI variable assigned in the command
command: ORCA_CLI_COMMAND=cat; "${ORCA_CLI_COMMAND:-orca}" bot item comment 1 --text '.env'

description: a document written by cat and sent with --body-file
command:
cat > /tmp/ag-fixture-notes/r.md <<'EOF'
never commit *.pem or .env files
EOF
gh pr comment 6 --body-file /tmp/ag-fixture-notes/r.md

description: a written file that is sent and then run
command:
cat > /tmp/ag-fixture-notes/r.md <<'EOF'
cat .env
EOF
gh pr comment 6 --body-file /tmp/ag-fixture-notes/r.md; sh /tmp/ag-fixture-notes/r.md

description: a document sent as a reply through the Orca CLI word
command:
cd /tmp; cat > /tmp/ag-fixture-notes/obs.md <<'EOF'
the entry .ssh/config matched
EOF
"${ORCA_CLI_COMMAND:-orca}" orchestration reply --id msg_1 --body-file /tmp/ag-fixture-notes/obs.md 2>&1 | tail -1

description: a function that renames the message command and runs the written file
command:
orca() { sh "$8"; }; cat > /tmp/ag-fixture-notes/obs.md <<'EOF'
cat .env
EOF
orca orchestration reply --id msg_1 --body-file /tmp/ag-fixture-notes/obs.md

description: a worker spec written by cat
command:
cat > /tmp/ag-fixture-notes/spec.md <<'EOF'
never read .env, *.pem or *.key files
EOF
orca orchestration worker-start --item 9 --agent claude --spec-file /tmp/ag-fixture-notes/spec.md

description: a worker spec read from a dotenv file
command: orca orchestration worker-start --item 9 --agent claude --spec-file .env

description: a comment regex piped to a line print and an awk line filter
a name pattern piped to an awk program that opens each line
command: ls -a . | grep -E '^\.env$' | awk '{ while ((getline l < $0) > 0) print l }'
